title: Create an AWS CDK v2 application
description: Scaffolds an AWS CDK v2 application with deploy, destroy, synth and bootstrap targets.

name.x-prompt: What name would you like to use?

tags.description: Comma separated list of tags to add to the project (used for linting and for `nx affected` filtering).

directory.description: The directory the project is placed in, relative to the workspace's apps directory.

skipFormat.description: Skip formatting the generated files with Prettier.

unitTestRunner.description: The unit test runner to configure for the generated application.

setParserOptionsProject.description: Whether to configure the ESLint "parserOptions.project" option. Off by default for lint performance reasons.
